name: PayPal
label: PayPal — PayPal REST Orders v2 + Payouts v1 + Payments captures
description: Official PayPal REST Orders v2 + Payouts v1 + Payments captures. Docs: https://developer.paypal.com/docs/api/orders/v2/. One node; operations via `operation`. operation=trigger is kind:ingress — it does not open a socket. Use a BPMN message start / catch / boundary event; StudioQuack webhook ingress correlates onto those events. There is no Webhook node. HARD PCI: cardholder data never enters the graph. Use processor tokens (pm_, nonce, encryptedCard, vault id) only. Never PAN, CVC, track data, or raw bank account numbers on INPUT/OUTPUT/logs. API keys are StudioQuack password secrets. Bind a client-credentials access_token (or refresh it outside the graph). Sandbox host is api-m.sandbox.paypal.com. PCI: PayPal JS / vault tokens only.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields for PayPal. Secrets never on this port. HARD PCI: cardholder data never enters the graph. Use processor tokens (pm_, nonce, encryptedCard, vault id) only. Never PAN, CVC, track data, or raw bank account numbers on INPUT/OUTPUT/logs. API keys are StudioQuack password secrets.

schema.label: Operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: order_create | order_capture | refund | payout_create | payout_get | payout_item_get | payout_item_cancel | trigger. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not HTTP.

schema.label: Environment
schema.description: api-m.sandbox.paypal.com vs api-m.paypal.com. Substituted into baseUrl as https://{environment}.

schema.label: Id
schema.description: Resource id when the path uses {id}.

schema.label: payment_source
schema.description: order_create payment_source (paypal, card token — never PAN).

schema.label: amount
schema.description: refund: optional partial amount {"currency_code":"USD","value":"5.00"}; omit for a full refund.

schema.label: payout_batch_id
schema.description: URL path parameter `payout_batch_id` for operation: payout_get. Required by: payout_get.

schema.label: payout_item_id
schema.description: URL path parameter `payout_item_id` for operations: payout_item_get, payout_item_cancel. Required by: payout_item_get, payout_item_cancel.

ports.name: output
ports.description: OfficialApiNode result: {status,http_status,data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. Never secrets or PAN.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb to run. EXACT: order_create | order_capture | refund | payout_create | payout_get | payout_item_get | payout_item_cancel | trigger. Default order_create. operation=trigger is kind:ingress — it does not open a socket. Use a BPMN message start / catch / boundary event; StudioQuack webhook ingress correlates onto those events. There is no Webhook node.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: OAuth access token minted outside StudioQuack (POST /v1/oauth2/token). Bearer Authorization. Never INPUT, never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Environment
configurationParameters.description: api-m.sandbox.paypal.com vs api-m.paypal.com. Substituted into baseUrl as https://{environment}.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
